Docs.summary: Pass/fail threshold for the aggregate rubric score, on the same normalized 0.0-1.0 scale as the emitted `score`. When the runtime weighted average meets or exceeds this value, the result is `pass`. Defaults to 0.5 (equivalent to a raw 1-5 weighted average of 3.0). The 'any dimension scored 1 → fail' rule still applies regardless of this threshold.
